instructions: Read the skill instructions for syncing expenses for yesterday.
Resolve yesterday and today using the runtime-injected date and the routine filename convention routine/[Month]/[Month] [Day] - [Weekday].md.
Read yesterday's routine note before creating or modifying today's note.
Extract only unchecked task lines matching '- [ ] ...' from yesterday's note. Do not copy checked tasks, headings, events, notes, or template placeholder text.
Create today's note at the resolved today path with the template below.
Append the extracted unchecked task lines under today's Summary section. If there are no unchecked tasks, leave the Summary section with only the template tasks.
If today's note already exists, read it and append the carried-forward tasks under Summary instead of using create_new.
Keep the source note unchanged and do not duplicate a task already present in today's note.
